design.decision: Win [♦] tricks either with top [♦]s or by staying void and trumping; it shapes when to keep or shed [♦]s.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first such win; opponents avoid leading [♦] into a void.
design.rationale: Both lines of a [♦] plan score here (honors win the suit, a void trumps it), which fixes the length line's main threat of [♦]s being trumped.
design.draftText: +20 contract points when your team wins a trick led with [♦]
design.hooks: Win trigger with an optional filter on the led card ("led") instead of the winning card.

critic.concerns: New led-card filter is clean and rewards both the honor line and the void line; opponents can see it and stop leading [♦].
